productTypes.title: Product types
productTypes.description: Which openFDA enforcement endpoints to search. All three by default. Results are interleaved and every row is tagged with productType.

reportDateFrom.title: Report date from
reportDateFrom.description: Earliest FDA enforcement-report date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Defaults to one year ago. Note this is when FDA published the report, which can be months after the recall started.

reportDateTo.title: Report date to
reportDateTo.description: Latest FDA enforcement-report date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD. Defaults to today.

classifications.title: Classifications
classifications.description: Recall severity. Class I = reasonable probability of serious harm or death, Class II = temporary/reversible harm, Class III = unlikely to cause harm. Leave empty for all.

states.title: Recalling firm states
states.description: Two-letter US state codes of the RECALLING FIRM (not where the product was distributed — see distributionPattern in the output for that). Leave empty for all.

status.title: Recall status
status.description: Filter by FDA recall status. Leave empty for all.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Free-text phrase matched against product description, reason for recall and recalling firm name. One distinctive word works better than a long phrase.

order.title: Sort order
order.description: Sort by report date, newest or oldest first.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many recalls in total across all selected product types.
